senses.definition: n.[m.] prob. something netted, i.e. either a quilt or (EwH 3. 77 Ke) a fly-net (κωνωπεῖον) spread over the face while a person was asleep; 1 S 19:13, 16 כְּבִיר הָעִזִּים a quilt (or fly-net) of goats(’ hair). Vid. further Drad loc.
